In Islamic tradition, Qareeb is a name that signifies a person who is close to Allah, and who has a strong bond with Him. It is also a name that is associated with qualities such as affection, love, and intimacy. In Arabic, the word Qareeb is used to describe a person who is near or close to someone else, whether it be a friend, family member, or Allah Himself.
